development_findings.detail: Initial fixture lacked Store.lease; added it. Child CLI help test removed inherited NODE_TEST_CONTEXT.
Recorded initial transport run was 27/29. Raw-body test map overwrote the first health response with the last; fixed to preserve each response.
The initial overall deadline could be reported as request timeout after timer rounding. Deadline kind is now fixed by the limiting budget and delay is rounded upward.

limitations: Local source integrity does not independently authenticate broker/provider or training provenance.
The snapshot GET persists bounded metadata in the existing runtime; there are no broker/order/configuration calls.
Complete collection is transport/integrity completion, not economic completeness or level 4.
No observed account collection was performed.
One local synthetic timing sample is not a production latency percentile or performance improvement.
Account pages are revision-bound and fail on change; there is no cross-request ledger snapshot or infinite retry.
Deadlines depend on event-loop resumption; byte limits apply to retained application data, not already-in-flight socket bytes.
POSIX permissions are not a portable privacy guarantee on every filesystem.
